prompts.user_prompt: 请将下面的项目进度说明改写成一份正式、清晰但不过度客套的内部邮件，正文控制在400至500字，并完整保留事实：数据清洗已经完成约八成；两类异常记录还需要业务人员确认；原定周五提交的分析报告可能推迟到下周二；目前不影响后续模型训练，但会压缩复核时间。邮件需要说明现状、影响、下一步安排以及需要收件人协助确认的事项。不要使用项目符号。

A software service recorded weekly incident counts of 18, 11, 15, 9, and 7. Median recovery times were 42, 39, 61, 34, and 31 minutes. Write a 600-750 word analysis with the headings Observations, Competing Explanations, What the Data Cannot Show, and Next Measurements. Avoid claiming causation, discuss the unusual third week, and recommend exactly four additional measurements.
prompts.system_prompt: You are a careful technical analyst. Separate observations from inference and preserve all supplied numbers.
